integrity.proof_basis: explicit Jacobian block decomposition, canonical Hopf coefficient, and local bifurcation theorem
integrity.provenance: standalone mathematical analysis of a deterministic specialization

scientific_limitations: The result is a local Hopf theorem for a deterministic mixed-sign two-species, two-stage matrix, not a random-ensemble statement.
The strictly positive attracting cycle is proved for sufficiently small positive parameter distance from the threshold, with no explicit neighborhood width.
No global attractor, full basin, ecological parameter calibration, or behavior far beyond threshold is asserted.
Full supplementary material of the motivating arXiv work was not accessible; accessible main text was examined.
title: Supercritical oscillations from zero-mean stage interactions in a two-species community
